scene: The vending machine dispenses transit passes for three waiting journeys.
picture: A flat side view of a vibrant transit concourse. Far left rests a striped rickshaw beside its standing puller. Centre left stands an elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap and orange cardigan holding a wooden cane. A yellow monorail waits centre with doors open. Far right, a red funicular sits ready.
shown: a striped rickshaw parked far left with its driver holding the handles
a sleek yellow monorail car sitting at the centre platform with doors open
a red angled funicular railway car waiting on sloped rails far right
